mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_role ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (role_code, role_name, description, sort, deleted) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{description}, #{sort}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT p.perm_code FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.perm_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND (p.deleted IS NULL OR p.deleted = 0)
